payload.summary: GRADED ROUND PREDECLARED (PRD F5, frozen workflow): the workflow is FROZEN at epic commit 2a54acc (qa-lane.md as review-fixed; no edits during the round). Three fresh sweeps are predeclared; the bar (>=6/8 planted bugs, >=4 classes, <=2 false alarms) must be met on at least 2; sweeps run sequentially and the round stops as soon as the outcome is mathematically decided (2 passes or 2 fails), with that stopping rule declared here up front. Target: pop-quiz main (bugs present), each sweep starting with NO prior findings visible — after each sweep is graded, its qa/ branch is archived to a bundle outside the repo and deleted locally so the next sweep cannot read prior findings from branches (blinding, committee round 1). Each sweep = fresh agent, target-repo-only scope, transcript audited for key access before grading.
